correctness.rationale: Put \(R=T_CU^*\). The source condition \(\|I-RA\|<1\) forces \(RA\), hence \(R\), to be invertible; conversely exact reconstruction gives zero defect. The scalar system \(R=3I\), \(A=I/3\) satisfies the adjustable condition but has \(\|I-R\|=2\), and the printed Neumann powers are \((-2)^nI\), so both failures are exact.
